column1: # Any ESP32 variant with 8MB. Any device role.
# Verify a board's real flash with:  esptool.py --port COMx flash_id
#   0x00D000   otadata       8 KB   which app slot to boot
#   0x610000   storage    1.94 MB   staging area for firmware images
# 1.94 MB of storage holds roughly two firmware images
# board can act as a controller and push updates to leaf nodes.
